title: Number of 1 Bits
keyIdea: n & (n − 1) clears the lowest set bit (n − 1 flips that 1 and the 0s below it). Repeat until n is 0 and count the steps: one step per 1 bit.

approaches.name: Check every bit
approaches.idea: I wrote this one too: add x & 1, shift right, 32 times.

approaches.name: Drop the lowest set bit
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code): while n != 0, n &= n − 1, count++.
